one_liner: Mid-senior analyst at Coast Guard headquarters helping run a major cutter/boat acquisition program: schedules, budgets, contracts, briefings, and congressional inquiries.
fit_summary: GS-13 needs a year at GS-12 level in program management, budget execution, schedules and contract oversight. Daniel's IEM work covers parts of it (logistics and on-site support to project managers at multi-state COVID-19 sites, spending trackers, vendor relationships) but not budget execution or contract oversight at that level, so GS-11/12 analyst roles fit better.
eligibility: Open to the public (direct hire); U.S. citizenship and Selective Service registration or exemption required.

One full year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-12, such as program reporting, Integrated Government Schedules, budget execution and analysis, COR duties, CPARS, and risk management; education cannot substitute.
Must pass a background investigation for a Public Trust position (no security clearance required).
All qualifications must be met by the closing date, November 7, 2026.
strategy: Apply only if he can show a full year of program management, budget tracking and schedule work at a senior level from IEM; otherwise prioritize GS-9 to GS-12 analyst roles.

Frame his IEM experience from the government-program side: work for federal, state and county clients, on-site support to project managers at multi-state COVID-19 sites, and order and spending tracking. Mention schedules, briefings or task-order support only where he did them.
Within the two-page limit, give each IEM role its title, dates, and hours per week. Write specific bullets in your own words, because text copied from the announcement is disregarded.
Highlight your policy knowledge as readiness to draft responses to congressional inquiries and to brief external stakeholders.
The questionnaire is not scored under direct hire, but answer it truthfully and make sure your resume supports every claim.
The application window is only Oct 29 to Nov 7, 2026, so have the resume finished before the posting opens.
resume_bullets: Tracked orders and expenditures for multi-state COVID-19 medical supply purchasing in Excel pivot-table reports (2021–2022).
Researched multimillion-dollar federal opportunities in SAM.gov, GovWin and the DHS acquisition forecast, and led proposal writing (2019–2024).
Delivered detailed notes used to write after-action reports for FEMA full-scale exercises.
interview_questions: Tell us about a time you briefed senior leadership on a complex program's status and risks.
How have you coordinated competing priorities among matrixed stakeholders to keep a schedule on track?
Describe your experience tracking budgets, obligations, or contract deliverables.
How would you research and respond to a congressional inquiry about a program's history and status?
watch_outs: The specialized-experience bar is high and acquisition- and budget-specific; consulting experience without budget, COR, or schedule work may be rated not qualified.
The roughly 9-day open window is easy to miss.
The job is in DC with telework but not remote, so expect a commute from Manassas on in-office days.
